text_block_list.text:
Verxina sprinted through her first three years
giving it her all as the great elder sister.
And now, she—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —There, all clean now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If you get cream on your face again,
I'll wipe it off for you, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Maybe I should get some on you on purpose then♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, geez...
Fine, that works too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're such a spoiled baby♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...
What on earth is with
this... overly sweet atmosphere...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... It feels even more
amazing than usual—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Chevaaalll!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair.
Chatting only with Trainer-san like that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Tell your big sis
anything and everything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!
So much had happened over the past three years... but now that things had settled down, Verxina was fully enjoying her time with her younger sisters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Now, what should we do next?
Shall we go eat something you like, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"For times like this, I gathered info on shops that serve giant meat buns.
First, in Yokohama—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I think I'll
take my leave here...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh... is that so?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!
I-It's not that I hate it or anything...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I need to... get ready
for the next race."

Cheval Grand had made a successful debut recently,
and was now undergoing serious, full-fledged training.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...You're going to keep growing rapidly from here on out, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm so very happy, but...
at the same time, I feel a little lonely...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Sounding like a parent again...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I definitely won't be able to do as well as big sis...
so please... don't get your hopes up."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
!
That couldn't be—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still...
...I plan on doing things... my own way.”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—At least enough so that I won't
bring shame to Verxina as her sister.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, in that case,
I guess I'll go train too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to be your beloved,
pride-and-joy little sister, after all♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, I'm rooting for you!
Your big sister won't lose either, you know!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Now it's just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My, those girls
have grown so dependable...

Just then, I suddenly...
noticed a change in Verxina.
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to use a handkerchief?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay!
...Just a little, though...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...May I stay
by your side?"

"The unmistakable growth of her little sisters
will surely become a source of strength for Verxina as well.
And so... her story continues."
